Blood.Manipulation.title: Blood Manipulation
Blood.Manipulation.description: You have obtained the power to manipulate your own blood

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{bloodweaver:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Blood Manipulation","color":"#ff0000","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}

commands: execute if entity @e[tag=Blood.Puddle,type=armor_stand,limit=1,sort=nearest,distance=..2] run scoreboard players add @s Blood.Amount 6
execute if entity @e[tag=Blood.Puddle,type=armor_stand,limit=1,sort=nearest,distance=..2] run playsound minecraft:entity.slime.attack master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s Blood.Amount matches 100.. run scoreboard players set @s Blood.Amount 100

first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Blood.Orb.Number matches 1.. run particle block redstone_block ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1 0 100 force
execute if score @s EOP.Blood.Orb.Number matches 1.. run playsound eop:splash master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s EOP.Blood.Spike.Number matches 1.. run particle block redstone_block ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1 0 100 force
execute if score @s EOP.Blood.Spike.Number matches 1.. run playsound eop:splash master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if entity @s[nbt={Inventory:[{id:"eop:blood_scythe"}]}] run particle block redstone_block ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1 0 100 force
execute if entity @s[nbt={Inventory:[{id:"eop:blood_scythe"}]}] run playsound eop:splash master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2

Secondary.Ability.title: Blood Meteorite
Secondary.Ability.description: Create orbs made of compressed blood to use as dangerous projectiles. §dBattlemode §fmust be enabled via keybind. §dRight Click §fto use this ability

Scythe.Unlock.title: Blood Edge
Scythe.Unlock.description: Create a scythe made out of dense blood

Red.Scale.Unlock.title: Flowing Red Scale
Red.Scale.Unlock.description: Increase the rate that your blood flows throughout your body. This increases strength and speed

Slicing.Exorcism.Unlock.title: Slicing Exorcism
Slicing.Exorcism.Unlock.description: Create sharp spikes of blood that deal significant damage

Super.Nova.Unlock.title: Super Nova
Super.Nova.Unlock.description: Form blood orbs around an entity that explode after a few seconds. §dTargets the entity you are looking at

Piercing.Blood.Unlock.title: Piercing Blood
Piercing.Blood.Unlock.description: Create a deadly compressed blood beam fired from your hands

commands_on_entity_hit: execute if entity @s[tag=Blood.Poisoned] run effect give @e[distance=..1,tag=!Bloodweaver,limit=1,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity] poison 10 1 true
